scope: Segment DL7 TLV download-data container, using Segment-Length-based framing rather than the DL1-DL6 Data-Type/End-of-Data marker pattern

rules.title: Segment DL7 is identified by the special character '^' (Data Type Indicator, Element 24) but, UNLIKE Segments DL1-DL6, does NOT use an End-of-Data Indicator; instead it uses a Segment Length Indicator (Element 84) to frame the segment, matching the pattern used by numbered segments (100-157) rather than the DL1-DL6 marker convention
rules.note: A genuinely distinctive hybrid: DL7/DL8 combine the DL-family's Data Type Indicator with the numbered-segment family's Segment Length Indicator, and drop the End-of-Data Indicator entirely.

rules.title: Segment Length Indicator (Element 84) for Segment DL7 is EXCLUSIVE of the Data Type Indicator's length — a distinct counting convention from most numbered segments, which INCLUDE the Segment Type's length in their Segment Length
Download Data (Element 232, max 100 characters) is required, in <tag><len><data> format, with detailed layout defined in Appendix W (Download Data Layout)
